## OTA updates
This device supports OTA updates, for more information see [OTA updates](../guide/usage/ota_updates.md).


## Options
*[How to use device type specific configuration](../guide/configuration/devices-groups.md#specific-device-options)*

* `simulated_brightness`: Simulate a brightness value. If this device provides a brightness_move_up or brightness_move_down action it is possible to specify the update interval and delta. The action_brightness_delta indicates the delta for each interval. Example:
```yaml
simulated_brightness:
  delta: 20 # delta per interval, default = 20
  interval: 200 # interval in milliseconds, default = 200
```


## Exposes

### Battery (numeric)
Remaining battery in %.
Value can be found in the published state on the `battery` property.
To read (`/get`) the value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/get` with payload `{"battery": ""}`.
It's not possible to write (`/set`) this value.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### Voltage (numeric)
Reported battery voltage in millivolts.
Value can be found in the published state on the `voltage` property.
To read (`/get`) the value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/get` with payload `{"voltage": ""}`.
It's not possible to write (`/set`) this value.
The unit of this value is `mV`.

### Level up step size (numeric)
Brightness step when turning up.
Value can be found in the published state on the `level_up_step_size` property.
To read (`/get`) the value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/get` with payload `{"level_up_step_size": ""}`.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"level_up_step_size": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `1` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### Level down step size (numeric)
Brightness step when turning down.
Value can be found in the published state on the `level_down_step_size` property.
To read (`/get`) the value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/get` with payload `{"level_down_step_size": ""}`.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"level_down_step_size": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `1` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

Value can be found in the published state on the `color_temp_up_step_size` property.
To read (`/get`) the value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/get` with payload `{"color_temp_up_step_size": ""}`.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"color_temp_up_step_size": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `1` and the maximum value is `254`.
The unit of this value is `mired`.

### Color temp down step size (numeric)
Color temperature step when turning down.
Value can be found in the published state on the `color_temp_down_step_size` property.
To read (`/get`) the value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/get` with payload `{"color_temp_down_step_size": ""}`.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"color_temp_down_step_size": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `1` and the maximum value is `254`.

### Level color mode (enum)
Automatically return to brightness control after 10 seconds.
Value can be found in the published state on the `level_color_mode` property.
To read (`/get`) the value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/get` with payload `{"level_color_mode": ""}`.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"level_color_mode": "VALUE"}`.
The possible values are: `brightness_only`, `auto_switch`.

### Action (enum)
Triggered action (e.g. a button click).
Value can be found in the published state on the `action` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The possible values are: `hold`, `double`, `on`, `off`, `toggle`, `brightness_move_to_level`, `brightness_move_up`, `brightness_move_down`, `brightness_step_up`, `brightness_step_down`, `brightness_stop`, `color_temperature_step_up`, `color_temperature_step_down`, `color_temperature_move_up`, `color_temperature_move_down`, `color_temperature_move_stop`, `color_temperature_move`.
